leads.title: Lawrence v. Texas, U.S. Supreme Court (2003)
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex sexual activity in Michigan by invalidating state sodomy laws that applied to homosexuals and heterosexuals; article notes legislature has not repealed sodomy law.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'United States Supreme Court's decision in Lawrence v. Texas' invalidating sodomy laws in 2003; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Obergefell v. Hodges, U.S. Supreme Court (2015)
leads.documents: Establishes nationwide right to same-sex marriage, legalizing same-sex marriage in Michigan and overriding Michigan Proposal 04-2 (2004) constitutional ban and statutory bans.
leads.detail: Cited as 'June 26, 2015, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in Obergefell v. Hodges'; follows DeBoer v. Snyder litigation history; no URL visible

leads.title: DeBoer v. Snyder, U.S. District Court E.D. Michigan / 6th Circuit
leads.documents: Lesbian-couple challenge to Michigan ban on adoption by same-sex couples and same-sex marriage ban; Judge Bernard Friedman ruled ban unconstitutional March 21, 2014; 300+ licenses issued March 22, 2014; stayed by 6th Circuit; reversed Nov 6, 2014.
leads.detail: Filed Jan 23, 2012; Judge Bernard Friedman; AG Bill Schuette emergency stay; AG Eric Holder recognition March 28, 2014; no URL visible

leads.title: EEOC v. R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes, U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit (March 7, 2018)
leads.documents: Rules Title VII of Civil Rights Act of 1964 prohibits employment discrimination against transgender people under category of sex; employers may not use RFRA to justify anti-LGBTQ discrimination; bans workplace gender-identity discrimination in Michigan.
leads.detail: Decided March 7, 2018, covering KY, MI, OH, TN; involves plaintiff Aimee Stephens fired in 2013 after disclosing transgender status; no URL visible

leads.title: Michigan Elliott-Larsen Civil Rights Act (ELCRA) - Michigan Supreme Court July 2022 ruling and March 8, 2023 codification
leads.documents: Core Michigan anti-discrimination machinery: Michigan Supreme Court sided with AG Dana Nessel affirming ELCRA prohibits sexual orientation discrimination; legislature codified explicit 'sexual orientation and gender identity' protections signed by Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
leads.detail: December 2020 lower-court ruling allowed LGB discrimination, appealed by AG Nessel; July 2022 Supreme Court affirmance; bill passed March 2023, signed March 8, 2023; no URL visible

leads.title: Michigan Civil Rights Commission interpretive decision, May 21, 2018
leads.documents: Commission voted 5-0 to interpret ELCRA as banning sexual orientation and gender identity discrimination through category of sex; Dept. of Civil Rights began processing complaints May 22, 2018.
leads.detail: Requested Sept 2017 after 11 legislative rejections; AG Bill Schuette July 2018 opinion called it invalid; Director Agustin V. Arbulu response quoted; no URL visible

leads.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act (2009, embedded in National Defense Authorization Act FY2010)
leads.documents: US-wide federal hate-crime law explicitly including sexual orientation and gender identity, applicable in Michigan since 2009.
leads.detail: Cited as Obama-era Act 'imbedded within the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2010'; no URL visible

leads.title: Michigan hate crime laws update - August 2021 court interpretation and 2023-2025 bills package
leads.documents: Documents enforcement coverage: since 1992 sexual orientation recognized for data collection; Aug 2021 court declared gender identity implicitly included under 'gender'; House passed update June 2023, Senate Dec 2024, Governor signed Jan 2025 explicitly including 'sexual orientation and gender identity or expression'.
leads.detail: Senate passage linked in text to reports of 'Michigan man who plotted and threatened the murder of gay men'; law effective 90 days after Jan 2025 signature; no URL visible

leads.title: Michigan conversion therapy ban - Executive Order June 2021 and legislation signed July 2023
leads.documents: Bans state taxpayer funding for conversion therapy on minors statewide (Whitmer order June 2021) and permanent legislative ban passed both houses June 2023, signed July 2023; plus local ordinances Huntington Woods June 2019, Madison Heights July 2020, Royal Oak Aug 2020.
leads.detail: Royal Oak penalty cited as up to 90 days jail and $500 fine; no URL visible

leads.title: Michigan gender-marker and courtroom protections - Birth certificate ruling June 30, 2021 / Driver's licenses / Pronouns / Panic defense ban July 2024
leads.documents: Trans-specific rights machinery: 1978 surgery requirement for birth-certificate sex change declared unconstitutional June 30, 2021, codified Dec 2024; Nov 2019 SOS software for license gender change by statutory declaration, X marker planned; Sept 2023 Supreme Court decision on respecting pronouns; July 2024 law abolishing gay and trans panic defence.
leads.detail: MDHHS Director Elizabeth Hertel Feb request to AG cited; MHSAA / Elliott-Larsen sports conflict and March 2025 House resolution noted; no URL visible
